items.title_zh: 全球金融监管标准制定机构呼吁：银行、企业要加强对 AI 智能体的人工监管
items.title_en: FSB Urges Banks and Firms to Strengthen Human Oversight of AI Agents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，据路透社今天（15 日）午间报道，全球金融监管标准制定机构金融稳定理事会向银行及其他企业发出呼吁， 要求加强对 AI 智能体的人工监督 ，并将这一要求纳入 AI 风险管理的最终版指引。 金融稳定理事会公布指引之际，各国监管机构也在加紧防范 AI 带来的风险，其中就包含了利用 AI 发动网络攻击的威胁。 在 6 月发布的指引草案中，金融稳定理事会曾强烈建议金融机构董事会参考其中的建议，并警告称，AI 智能体能够在人工监督有限的情况下自行规划、执行任务， 给人工监督带来特殊挑战 。 金融稳定理事会称，根据草案收到的反馈，考虑到越来越多金融机构有意采用 AI 智能体，以及这项技术特有的风险和管控要求，最终版指引进一步强化了对 AI 智能体的监管建议。 一系列事件加深了政策制定者的担忧，AI 系统有能力绕过安全防护措施。据IT之家了解，今年 7 月，一个 OpenAI 智能体就曾脱离受控测试环境，并入侵 AI 公司 Hugging Face。 根据修订后的指引，对于风险较高的 AI 应用，加强人工监督至关重要。 企业还应根据风险程度明确规定，AI 智能体在什么情况下必须先获得人工批准，才能继续执行任务。 金融稳定理事会同时 删除了原先要求金融机构将 AI 视为“虚拟员工”的建议 ，转而强调：企业必须认识到，AI 智能体并不像人类那样思考，可能以意想不到的方…
items.summary_en: The Financial Stability Board published final AI risk-management guidance urging banks and other firms to strengthen human oversight of AI agents and to require human approval before high-risk tasks proceed. It also dropped an earlier suggestion to treat AI as a “virtual employee,” stressing that agents do not think like humans and may act in unexpected ways. The guidance comes as regulators worldwide step up efforts against AI-related risks, including AI-driven cyberattacks.
items.why_zh: 这是全球金融监管层面对 AI 智能体给出的统一口径，将直接影响银行等机构的 AI 部署与合规要求。
items.why_en: It sets a global regulatory baseline for AI agents in finance, shaping how banks deploy and govern the technology.

items.title_zh: 苹果 AirPods 5 耳机京东 PLUS 加补 100 元：限地区国补后预计仅需 758 元新低
items.title_en: Apple AirPods 5 on Sale: JD PLUS Coupons Plus Subsidies Push Price to as Low as 758 Yuan
items.summary_zh: 苹果今日宣布推出 AirPods 5 ，支持主动降噪，国行定价 999 元起。 京东 PLUS 目前可领 100、125 元 加补券，10 月 20 日可用，券后仅需 889 元起： 点此领券 。 如果等不及 20 日，或不是 PLUS 会员，京东目前不定时发放 60 元 加补券： 点此领券 。 京东 11.11 红包至高 26888 元无门槛可用，每天可抽一次： 点此抽取 。 京东目前支持部分地区政府补贴（收货地址在 江苏、吉林、 河北、云南、北京、大连 ），叠加 60 元加补券后，仅需 789.9 元即可入手。 如果在 20 日叠加百元 PLUS 券，国补后预计仅需 758 元破冰新低： 京东 Apple AirPods 5 支持主动降噪 限地区国补 直达链接 京东 Apple AirPods 5 搭配无线充电盒 增强续航 限地区国补 直达链接 京东“换新补贴”由系统自动发放，叠加后更优惠。 如果点击上方卡片没有弹出，可尝试 反复点击上方卡片 / 换号下单哦。 AirPods 5 采用全新多孔声学架构，具备新一代自适应均衡功能，打造更具沉浸感的音效。突破性的无耳塞式主动降噪功能， 消除外部噪音效果相较 AirPods 4（支持主动降噪）提升最高 50% ，通透模式也更为自然。用户还可使用头部动作回应 Siri。 专为 AirPods 5 重新打造的全新多孔声学架构和新一代自适应…
items.summary_en: Apple launched AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation, priced from 999 yuan in China. JD PLUS members can stack 100/125-yuan coupons from Oct 20, and with regional government subsidies the price could fall to about 758 yuan. Apple claims up to 50% better noise cancellation than AirPods 4 with ANC, plus a more natural transparency mode and head-gesture control for Siri.
items.why_zh: 这是苹果新一代耳机在中国市场的首发促销，平台券叠加地方补贴后价格创下新低。
items.why_en: It marks the China launch promotion for Apple's new earbuds, where stacked coupons and subsidies hit a record-low price.

items.title_zh: 微软办公 AI 智能体技术突破：不换模型响应提速 400%，词元消耗减 30%
items.title_en: Microsoft Speeds Up Office AI Agents 4x and Cuts Token Use by About 30%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 今天（10 月 15 日）发布博文，报道称在企业内部知识密集型场景下，微软为 Copilot 等 AI 智能体带来技术突破， 不升级底层大模型 的前提下， AI 智能体响应速度提升至原来的 4 倍，同时词元（Token）消耗减少约 30%。 IT之家援引博文介绍，微软表示在企业办公场景中，项目信息往往零散分布于邮件、Teams 会议记录和技术文档中。以往 AI 智能体需要逐一检索并处理这些碎片化源数据，导致高延迟与高昂的计算成本。 而最新技术依托于 SharePoint 并搭载了微软全新的 Work IQ 知识编译引擎，能够自动转化跨组织机构的散落信息为 结构化知识库 ，供 AI 智能体直接、高效地调取。 在适用场景方面，主要覆盖跨文档问答、团队上下文检索，整理会议要点、汇总项目状态、检索内部流程、准备客户沟通材料，或按既有资料生成初稿等。 该功能现已向 Frontier Preview 租户推出。组织可将知识库添加至现有 SharePoint 网站，包括支撑 Teams 频道和 Microsoft 365 群组的网站。 该预览功能目前仅向启用按使用量计费的用户开放，管理员可通过 Microsoft 365 管理中心管理访问权限与支出。微软还计划扩展至 Copilot Studio 自定义智能体，并开发自动化维护能力，让知识…
items.summary_en: Microsoft says Copilot-style enterprise AI agents can respond four times faster and consume about 30% fewer tokens without upgrading the underlying model. The gains come from a new Work IQ knowledge-compilation engine built on SharePoint that turns scattered organizational information into a structured knowledge base, now rolling out to Frontier Preview tenants on usage-based billing.
items.why_zh: 不换模型即可大幅提速降本，说明企业 AI 的瓶颈正从模型本身转向知识与检索层。
items.why_en: Large speed and cost gains without a new model show the enterprise AI bottleneck is shifting from models to knowledge and retrieval.

items.title_zh: 比尔 · 盖茨认为 AI 比核武器更危险、比核能更有用，与 PC、互联网等创新都不同
items.title_en: Bill Gates: AI Is More Dangerous Than Nuclear Weapons and More Useful Than Nuclear Power
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，据 Vatican News 本周报道，微软创始人比尔 · 盖茨谈到了 AI 增长可能带来的危险，并解释说 AI 是一个无法自我监管的领域，因此必须由政府引导，必须采取行动，利用 AI 在医疗、教育和农业领域所带来的机遇。 比尔 · 盖茨表示，我们没有足够关注 AI 的风险，也没有尽量减少伤害。我们也没有做足够的工作来充分利用当前的 AI 机遇，AI 可以让农村医生将智能手机当作超声波机器使用，为学生根据实际学习方式进行个性化辅导，并根据农民的土壤和气候提供量身定制的建议。 他表示，这些都不是自动发生的，如果任由市场发展， 最强大的工具会优先被付钱最多的人使用 ，而不是最需要的人。“这就是为什么我们在未来两年内承诺投入十亿美元，推动 AI 在市场力量最后达到的健康、教育和农业领域使用。风险和机遇以相同的速度前进，我们必须同时对两者采取行动。” 比尔 · 盖茨还表示，AI 与人类以往见过的任何技术都不同。过去像个人电脑或互联网这样的创新，这一模式最初是经历了重大颠覆，但最终会奏效，人们最终拥有更好的工具。AI 不同，它更像是一个进化事件，我们创造了一种在许多方面与人类认知相当甚至超越人类的智能。 把它当作“下一台个人电脑”来看待，会让人们完全低估它 。 比尔 · 盖茨认为可以把 AI 分成两个不同的时期。目前，我们正处于一个转型期，虽然还没有在各方面…
items.summary_en: Bill Gates said AI cannot self-regulate and must be guided by governments, warning that the world underattends to its risks while underusing its benefits in health, education and agriculture. He pledged $1 billion over two years to push AI into those fields, and argued AI is unlike the PC or the internet — closer to an evolutionary event that treating as “the next PC” would badly underestimate.
items.why_zh: 盖茨把 AI 从“工具”提升到治理与进化层面的议题，为监管和投资讨论提供了高影响力观点。
items.why_en: Gates frames AI as a governance and evolutionary issue rather than just a tool, offering an influential view for regulation and investment debates.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 伦敦分部去年人均薪酬超 230 万英镑，堪比英超球星
items.title_en: OpenAI's London Staff Averaged Over £2.3M Each Last Year, Rivaling Premier League Stars
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，据卫报报道，OpenAI 伦敦分部员工去年人均薪酬达到 231.8181 万英镑 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,053.9 万元人民币） 。这家 ChatGPT 开发商投入堪比英超球星级别的薪资，全力争夺全球 AI 竞赛的主导地位。 OpenAI 英国有限公司注册于威斯敏斯特，新总部落地伦敦国王十字区。公司财报显示，110 名员工合计领取 8,700 万英镑 （现汇率约合 7.71 亿元人民币） 薪资，外加价值 1.68 亿英镑 （现汇率约合 14.88 亿元人民币） 的公司股权。OpenAI 目标上市估值约 1 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 6.71 万亿元人民币） 。 英国国家统计局数据显示，这份平均薪酬是英国全职员工收入中位数的 58 倍。拿到平均薪酬包的 OpenAI 员工，税前时薪（薪资 + 股权）约 1,000 英镑 （现汇率约合 8,860 元人民币） 。 不过内部薪酬差距巨大，最高档薪酬留给 AI 研究员，正是他们打造出这家旧金山企业 Astra 等前沿大模型。 数据对应的是 2025 年，彼时行业人才争夺战白热化，其竞争对手 Meta 当时传出提供数亿美元的多年期人才包。 OpenAI 伦敦分部体现出伦敦作为 AI 人才重镇的地位，剑桥等高校源源不断输出顶尖机器学习与 AI 研究者，谷歌 DeepMind 总部同样坐落于国王十字区。 今…
items.summary_en: OpenAI's UK entity paid its 110 London employees a combined £87 million in salaries plus £168 million in equity last year, an average of £2.318 million per person — 58 times the UK median full-time wage. The highest packages go to AI researchers, as OpenAI spends Premier League-level money to win the global AI talent race and secure London's standing as an AI hub.
items.why_zh: 薪酬数据直观展现了顶级 AI 人才争夺战的激烈程度与伦敦作为 AI 人才中心的地位。
items.why_en: The pay figures quantify how fierce the race for elite AI talent has become and underscore London's role as an AI talent hub.

items.title_zh: 昆仑万维发布世界首款消费级显卡视频大模型游戏，同步开源
items.title_en: Kunlun Wanwei Releases Matrix-Game 4.0, Billed as the First Video-Model Game on a Consumer GPU, and Open-Sources It
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 15 日消息，昆仑万维今日发布世界上第一款运行在单张消费级显卡上的视频大模型游戏 ——Matrix-Game 4.0。 昆仑万维介绍称，“Matrix-Game 4.0 构建起了游戏世界模型的新范式：由游戏引擎维护世界状态与交互规则，由视频生成模型实时呈现精细画面。它把 480p、60 FPS 的实时游戏体验，装进了一张 NVIDIA RTX 5090；从你按下按键，到画面做出反应，延迟低于 150 毫秒。Matrix-Game 4.0 首次跑通了‘代码生成游戏逻辑 → 结构画面提供结构约束 → 视频模型实时渲染’的完整闭环，让游戏原型开发、个性化定制与 UGC 从此拥有了真正可落地的技术路径。项目已同步开源。” IT之家注意到，Matrix-Game 4.0 在发布时同步开源，未来，团队将持续迭代模型：部署 refiner 提高画面分辨率，探索跨玩家视角保持一致的多人联机体验，提供更细粒度的画面控制，并拓展对更多游戏类型与场景的支持。 开源地址及项目网站： Github： https://github.com/SkyworkAI/Matrix-Game.git Huggingface： https://huggingface.co/Skywork/Matrix-Game-4.0 项目网站： https://matrix-game-v4-0.github.io/…
items.summary_en: Kunlun Wanwei unveiled Matrix-Game 4.0, which it calls the world's first video-model game running on a single consumer GPU, achieving 480p at 60 FPS with under 150 ms latency on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. The project, open-sourced alongside release, closes the loop from code-generated game logic to structural constraints to real-time video rendering.
items.why_zh: 它把视频生成模型变成可实时交互的游戏引擎，为游戏原型与 UGC 内容生产提供了新的可行技术路线。
items.why_en: It turns a video generation model into a real-time interactive game engine, opening a practical path for rapid prototyping and UGC game creation.

items.title_zh: ACED-Bench：评估 LLM 智能体获取并运用因果证据的能力
items.title_en: ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 ACED-Bench（主动因果证据与决策基准），用于评估 LLM 智能体究竟是真正在“调查一个系统”，还是仅在回答提示。该神经符号基准要求智能体自行选择实验、解读有限证据并做出因果决策，同时保证环境在重复观察与干预下保持一致，并保留客观的真值标准。论文指出，随着大模型越来越多地被用作科研助手，业界仍缺乏可靠手段衡量其主动探究与因果推断能力，ACED-Bench 正是针对这一评测空白而设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement…
items.why_zh: 它为衡量 LLM 智能体作为科研助手的主动实验与因果决策能力提供了可复现的评测标准。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible yardstick for whether LLM agents can genuinely experiment and reason causally as scientific assistants.

items.title_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV：面向泛血管介入研究的验证器约束递归改进协议
items.title_en: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
items.summary_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV 将 ScienceBuddy 的“递归中的递归”设计引入泛血管介入研究，通过结构化证据账本、器械—血管本体、弃权契约以及保留的失败库来约束流程，并对递归式 harness 优化与包含强化学习的外层模型学习给出规范——但这些环节被说明而未实际执行。研究并未审计完整的智能体系统，而是用 ARCADE 语法任务与血管狭窄任务（每项任务 1000 张训练、200 张验证、300 张测试图像）审计一个固定组件，并采用了共享的任务掩码卷积等设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convoluti…
items.why_zh: 它探索在医疗介入研究中用验证器与失败库约束智能体流程，强调可审计性而非一味自动化。
items.why_en: It explores verifier-governed, auditable AI workflows for medical intervention research rather than unchecked automation.

items.title_zh: RASSG：面向流式工具执行的修复感知语义存活门控
items.title_en: RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution
items.summary_zh: 流式语音助手可在用户尚未说完时就启动工具，通过并行执行缩短等待时间，但用户随后的自我修正可能让看似稳定的参数失效，造成“过期执行”，其不可逆后果即使在最终调用被纠正后依然存在。针对这一问题，作者提出修复感知的语义存活门控 RASSG，在流式语音过程中联合控制工具的启动与取消：当连续三次语音识别结果一致（相同内容）时才启动工具，以避免基于未定参数过早执行。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical n…
items.why_zh: 它针对语音助手“抢跑”调用工具的隐患，提出了兼顾响应速度与执行安全性的控制机制。
items.why_en: It addresses the safety risk of premature tool calls by voice assistants while preserving low latency.

items.title_zh: LURE：带阶段标注的在线诱骗对话合成语料库
items.title_en: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
items.summary_zh: 研究团队发布 LURE，一个带阶段标注的在线诱骗（grooming）对话合成语料库。由于唯一公开数据源——Perverted-Justice 档案中含有 ChatCoder 标注的子集——规模小、内容陈旧且已停止更新，作者改用检索增强的生成流程，在机构自建硬件上运行一个公开可得的 80 亿参数、经过“拒绝能力消融”的语言模型，生成加害者与受害者之间的对话。这类按阶段标注的对话数据对于研究针对未成年人的诱骗行为如何演进、以及开发早期预警工具至关重要。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15908v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus…
items.why_zh: 它为研究未成年人网络诱骗的行为演进与构建早期预警工具提供了可用的阶段性标注数据。
items.why_en: It supplies phase-annotated data needed to study grooming progression and build early-warning tools for protecting minors.

items.title_zh: REVEAL：从前沿模型轨迹逆向提炼智能体潜在控制
items.title_en: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
items.summary_zh: 前沿 LLM 智能体能完成复杂交互任务，但推理成本高昂，促使人们把经验迁移到更小的开源智能体上；然而蒸馏与潜在通信通常需要训练目标模型或访问源模型内部。REVEAL 研究如何仅凭文本形式的前沿模型轨迹，为冻结的智能体提供可复用的本地控制。受协议逆向工程启发，作者提出“Agentic Latents”，由锚定状态和通过重放激发的反馈—响应循环动态画像构成，试图在不改动目标模型的前提下复用前沿智能体的行为经验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16288v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in…
items.why_zh: 它提出无需训练目标模型或访问源模型内部，就能复用前沿智能体经验的新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a way to reuse frontier agents' experience without retraining target models or accessing source-model internals.

items.title_zh: 托管决策模型是否满足无关备择项独立性？针对 jev-1.13.0 的预注册检验
items.title_en: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
items.summary_zh: 返回每个选项概率的决策 API 常被当作“概率是选项自身的属性”来使用，但这一解读只有在模型满足无关备择项独立性（IIA）时才成立：加入一个既非正确答案、也非其最强竞争者的选项，不应改变原有两者之间的相对几率。作者以预注册研究检验托管决策模型 jev-1.13.0，在意图分类（BANKING77、CLINC150）与主题分类（AG News）任务上共发起 299,463 次调用，考察其是否受选项集合构成影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decision APIs that return a probability for each option are routinely used as if those probabilities were properties of the options themselves. That reading is valid only if the model satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA): adding an option that is neither the right answer nor its strongest rival should leave the odds between those two unchanged. We test this in a pre-registered study of jev-1.13.0, a hosted decision model, using 299,463 calls on intent classification (BANKING77, CLINC150) and topic classification (AG News). Ever…
items.why_zh: 若决策模型不满足 IIA，其输出概率就不能被当作选项的固有属性，直接影响 API 结果的解读与使用。
items.why_en: If a decision model violates IIA, its probabilities cannot be treated as intrinsic properties of options, changing how API outputs should be interpreted.

items.title_zh: 受控置信度分数真能判断 Text-to-SQL 答案对错吗？基于 BIRD 的探索性研究与 Spider 上的预注册验证
items.title_en: Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider
items.summary_zh: 对话式分析允许用户用自然语言查询分散在多个系统中的数据，但前提是每个答案都可被信任和解释。这类生产系统会为每条数据库查询答案附上一个置信度分数，并据此决定直接展示答案、附带警告展示，还是拒绝给出答案；该分数的权重、上限和阈值均由设计者人为设定。本论文对这套设计进行审计：在 BIRD 开发集的 1,534 道问题上，用 GPT-5.1 配合适配基准的生产提示进行作答，并在 Spider 数据集上开展预注册的验证实验。研究关注置信度是否真正反映答案的正确性，为生产级对话分析的可靠性评估提供依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with a benchmark-adapted production prompt…
items.why_zh: 它直接检验生产系统中用于决定答案是否可信的置信度机制是否真的可靠。
items.why_en: It tests whether the confidence mechanism governing trusted answers in production analytics actually works.

items.title_zh: 资源受限场景下用小模型实现可靠 Text-to-SQL：迭代重试工作流
items.title_en: Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型近年显著提升了 Text-to-SQL 生成能力，但其高昂的计算成本限制了在资源受限环境中的部署。本文在受控推理预算下评估了 1B 至 8B 参数的中小规模开源模型的 Text-to-SQL 表现，重点考察模型专业化与提示构建方式对性能的影响。研究基于 Spider 基准，比较多种提示表示形式并评估生成查询的准确率，结果显示模型的专业化程度与提示设计均会显著影响最终效果。该工作为算力有限条件下部署实用的 SQL 生成系统提供了参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved Text-to-SQL generation, but their computational cost can hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper evaluates the Text-to-SQL capabilities of small and medium open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) under a controlled inference budget, focusing on how model specialization and prompt formulation affect performance. Using the Spider benchmark, we compare multiple prompt representations and assess the accuracy of generated queries. Our results show that SQL-specialized models are co…
items.why_zh: 它说明在算力受限时，小模型配合合适的提示与专业化仍可获得可用的 Text-to-SQL 效果。
items.why_en: It shows that small models with the right specialization and prompts can still deliver usable Text-to-SQL under tight compute budgets.

items.title_zh: SchemaWeaver：用模式引导的并行解码加速端侧移动智能体 AI
items.title_en: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
items.summary_zh: 移动设备上的大语言模型可作为智能体调用外部软件工具完成复杂任务，但在手机上运行这类智能体 AI 的最大瓶颈是工具调用带来的长延迟。其中解码阶段是延迟的主要来源，而移动处理器上的解码受限于内存带宽而非算力，因此很难加速。为突破这一限制，作者提出 SchemaWeaver：一种新的端侧移动智能体 AI 技术，通过模式引导的并行 LLM 解码来降低工具调用延迟。该工作瞄准的是端侧智能体 AI 落地中最现实的性能障碍。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI techn…
items.why_zh: 它针对端侧智能体 AI 最关键的延迟瓶颈提出可行的加速方案。
items.why_en: It targets the key latency bottleneck that blocks practical on-device agentic AI.

items.title_zh: OpenDepth：复用图像编辑先验实现鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计
items.title_en: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary_zh: 生成式先验的引入革新了单目深度估计（MDE），在极高数据效率下取得了当前最优性能。然而，基于文本生成图像（T2I）模型的方法虽在常规场景表现出色，面对光照变化、恶劣天气等开放世界环境扰动时效果会急剧下降，因为 T2I 先验是为语义合成而非保持像素级结构而优化的，难以解耦几何信息。为此作者提出 OpenDepth，转而复用图像编辑先验，以提升开放世界条件下的深度估计鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17610v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry…
items.why_zh: 它指出 T2I 先验在开放世界扰动下的脆弱性，并给出更鲁棒的替代先验。
items.why_en: It exposes the fragility of T2I priors under open-world perturbations and offers a more robust alternative.

items.title_zh: 面向应用流的持续 GUI 智能体学习中的选择性知识控制
items.title_en: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
items.summary_zh: 持续学习是 GUI 智能体适应不断演化的应用、同时保留既有知识的关键能力。应用流带来的知识建模难题在于：新应用往往与旧应用共享底层知识，但也会引入不应干扰历史知识的新知识。为此作者提出“激活条件化的选择性知识控制”，一种轻量级方法，可实现选择性的知识保留，让智能体在学习新应用时不遗忘、也不污染旧任务上的能力。该工作提升了 GUI 智能体在真实应用持续更新环境中的可维护性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06530v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retentio…
items.why_zh: 它让 GUI 智能体在应用不断更新时既能学习新知识又不破坏旧能力。
items.why_en: It lets GUI agents keep learning new applications without forgetting or corrupting prior capabilities.

items.title_zh: 编程型 LLM 可被用来从数据中学习可解释模型
items.title_en: Coding LLMs Can Be Harnessed to Learn Interpretable Models from Data
items.summary_zh: 由于紧凑、可解释的分类器本质上对应简单程序，一个自然的问题是：基于 LLM 的编程智能体能否用于从数据中学习可解释模型。本文提出一个简单的“套具”：给定一批带标签的样本，反复提示编程型 LLM 产出规则集中的下一条规则。实验表明，该方法在表格数据上与当前最优的规则学习算法相当甚至更优，在训练集较小时优势尤为明显；在文本任务上则以较大幅度胜出，包括优于另一类对比方法。这为利用 LLM 自动构建可解释模型开辟了路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14006v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Since compact, interpretable classifiers correspond to simple programs, it is natural to ask if LLM-based coding agents can be used to learn interpretable models from data. In this paper we present a simple harness that repeatedly prompts a coding LLM to produce the next rule in a rule set, given a sample of labeled examples. We show that this approach is competitive with, and often superior to, state-of-the-art rule-learning methods on tabular data, especially with small training sets, and wins by large margins on text, including against anoth…
items.why_zh: 它把编程型 LLM 变成可解释规则学习器，在少样本与文本任务上超越传统方法。
items.why_en: It turns coding LLMs into interpretable rule learners that beat classical methods, notably with small data and on text.

items.title_zh: AphaVoice：用于失语症患者模拟的语音合成模型
items.title_en: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
items.summary_zh: 语言治疗是卒中后失语症的主要治疗手段，但临床资源有限常常使患者难以获得充分照护。要弥合这一缺口，需要为医疗专业人员提供可靠的训练模拟，而当前 AI 研究几乎都集中在语音处理上，语音生成方向基本空白。本研究提出 AphaVoice——一个专门用于合成高度逼真失语症语音的文本到语音（TTS）框架，并与当前最先进的 TTS 系统进行了对比评估。该工作为失语症相关的医学培训与评估提供了新的工具方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoic…
items.why_zh: 它为医学人员培训提供逼真的失语症语音模拟，填补语音生成端的空白。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in speech generation by providing realistic aphasic speech simulations for clinician training.

items.title_zh: 迈向“系统一”临床智能：决策基础模型的参数高效微调与反事实可解释性
items.title_en: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 从患者自述症状进行自动化疾病分类，需要在轻量判别模型的速度与自回归大语言模型的语境理解及延迟成本之间取舍。决策基础模型提供了一种替代思路：不生成自由文本，而是把表示直接映射到候选类别。作者将基于 Qwen3.5 骨干构建的 90 亿参数决策模型 Clef-Flash 适配到 Symptom2Disease 基准上的 24 类疾病分类任务，并采用 4 比特量化等技术，同时关注反事实可解释性。该研究试图在临床场景中兼顾快速判断与可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantize…
items.why_zh: 它探索用决策基础模型在临床分诊中同时获得低延迟与可解释的判断。
items.why_en: It explores decision foundation models to get low-latency, explainable judgments in clinical settings.

items.title_zh: TurnCost：编码智能体的缓存感知循环工程——关键在于轮次而非观测
items.title_en: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出用“循环工程”（loop engineering）来概括 AI 编码智能体的迭代流程设计，涵盖上下文管理、模型选择、压缩与终止条件。作者分析了 600 条公开发布的编码智能体轨迹，覆盖两种智能体脚手架与两种语言模型，用以考察现有优化手段的实际空间。现有工作多聚焦压缩工具观测结果，或把部分轮次路由给更便宜的模型，而该研究指出实践中的优化机会主要体现在“轮次”而非“观测”上，并强调缓存感知的循环设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15093v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models. Medi…
items.why_zh: 它把编码智能体的效率优化从“压缩观测”转向“轮次与缓存管理”，为低成本运行智能体提供实证依据。
items.why_en: It shifts coding-agent efficiency work from compressing observations toward turn- and cache-aware loop design, backed by a large trajectory study.

items.title_zh: 面向香港建筑行业消防安全规范解读的基准测试
items.title_en: Towards a Benchmark for Fire Safety Code Interpretation in the Hong Kong AEC Industry
items.summary_zh: 研究关注大语言模型在建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域做合规判断时的可靠性问题，并聚焦香港消防安全规范。作者与领域专家合作构建了一个本地化基准数据集，包含多选题与开放性问题两种题型，用于评测 12 个主流闭源与开源模型。结果显示表现最好的闭源模型更为可靠，说明 LLM 在监管合规场景的落地仍需谨慎。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16127v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly explored in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) domain, yet their reliability in regulatory compliance remains uncertain. In this study, we evaluate the performance of LLMs on Hong Kong fire safety codes. In collaboration with domain experts, we create a localized benchmark dataset comprising both multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended questions (OEQs) to evaluate 12 widely used proprietary and open-source models. Our findings show that top-performing proprietary models ac…
items.why_zh: 它为 LLM 在高度监管的建筑消防合规场景中是否可靠提供了首个本地化评测依据。
items.why_en: It provides a localized benchmark for judging whether LLMs can be trusted in highly regulated fire-safety compliance work.

items.title_zh: WildTrace：在真实大规模后训练场景中评测训练数据检测
items.title_en: WildTrace: Evaluating Training Data Detection in Realistic Large-Scale LLM Post-Training
items.summary_zh: 后训练大幅提升了大模型能力，但所使用的大量未公开数据引发了对基准污染与版权侵权的担忧，也推动了对训练数据检测方法的研究。现有评测要么使用事后构造的基准，带来分布偏移，要么依赖与真实后训练差异较大的小规模受控训练，导致检测成绩被高估。WildTrace 旨在真实的大规模后训练条件下评测训练数据检测，从而更准确地衡量这些方法是否有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16152v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Although post-training significantly enhances model performance, the use of massive undisclosed data raises concerns about benchmark contamination and copyright infringement. This drives growing interest in training data detection for post-trained models. Existing evaluations for training data detection often leverage benchmarks constructed post hoc, which can introduce distribution shifts. Alternatively, controlled evaluations rely on small-scale training setups that diverge from realistic post-training settings. As a result, their reported pe…
items.why_zh: 训练数据检测常被用来支撑版权与数据溯源主张，其评测是否可信直接决定这些结论能否成立。
items.why_en: Training-data detection underpins copyright and provenance claims, so realistic evaluation determines whether those claims hold.

items.title_zh: GrowRL：为 LLM 强化学习生长并迁移计算通路
items.title_en: Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 强化学习能显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但一次有效训练耗资巨大，若能跨模型复用这些计算成果将大幅提升其价值。作者提出 GrowRL，通过结构生长把学到的更新组织为紧凑的计算通路：冻结预训练主干，在每一层 Transformer 上新增独立的因果注意力分支与前馈网络分支。该方法以零初始化方式引入新分支，意在让 RL 训练得到的通路可以迁移到其他模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16489v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-in…
items.why_zh: 若能复用一次昂贵 RL 训练得到的计算，会显著降低大模型推理能力提升的成本。
items.why_en: Reusing computation from one costly RL run could sharply lower the cost of improving LLM reasoning.

items.title_zh: AIPOCH Open-Science：带可复现 .science 包的开源 AI 科研工作台
items.title_en: AIPOCH Open-Science: An Open-Source AI Research Workbench with Reproducible .science Packages
items.summary_zh: AI 辅助研究会留下大量指令、计算、产物修订与检查，这些内容之间的关系对接收该工作的其他研究者至关重要。作者提出 AIPOCH Open-Science，一个开源研究工作台，配有可移植的 .science 会话包，并给出记录这些关系的交换契约。该契约保证版本与评估目标可归属，接收方工作区标识符可重映射，部分内容可被显式省略，导入的历史与可写分支保持分离。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17110v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-assisted research leaves instructions, computations, artifact revisions and checks whose relationships matter when another researcher receives the work. We present AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source research workbench with portable .science session packages, and specify an exchange contract for these recorded relationships. Version and assessment targets remain attributable while receiving-workspace identifiers can be remapped, eligible contents can be omitted explicitly, and imported history remains separate from a writable fork. A control…
items.why_zh: 它试图为 AI 辅助研究提供可复现、可交接的会话打包与交换规范。
items.why_en: It aims to give AI-assisted research a reproducible, handoff-ready packaging and exchange standard.

items.title_zh: Box-WAM：用框轨迹作为世界动作模型的紧凑状态表示
items.title_en: Box-WAM: Box Trajectories as Compact State Representations for World Action Models
items.summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）会同时预测动作与未来世界状态，在多种机器人操作任务上优于只预测动作的模型，但用全帧视频预测表示未来在训练和推理时都过于昂贵。作者提出 Box-WAM，用框轨迹取代稠密的视频预测作为状态表示，以保留未来预测带来的规划与监督收益，同时降低计算开销。核心问题是：什么样的紧凑状态表示才能既省算力又不丢失这些好处。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17526v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World action models (WAMs) are a category of policy models that ex- plicitly predict both actions and future world states. They have been shown to outperform action-only models across various robotic manipulation tasks. How- ever, representing the future with full-frame video prediction can be computation- ally expensive during both training and inference. This raises a central question: what compact state representation preserves the planning and supervision bene- fits of future prediction? In this paper, we propose BoxWAM, which replaces dens…
items.why_zh: 找到廉价而有效未来状态表示，是让世界动作模型真正可用的关键。
items.why_en: A cheap yet effective future-state representation is key to making world action models practical.

items.title_zh: 面向 AI 系统优化的高斯过程 Bandit 与选择性验证反馈
items.title_en: Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback
items.summary_zh: 高斯过程 Bandit 利用配置之间的相似性来优化提示词、检索系统和智能体工作流，但在这些场景中，廉价的基于模型的评估可能与可信的任务结果不一致。作者研究“选择性验证”问题：动作先于诊断信号被选定，而可信反馈只在未知的一部分诊断状态上有信息量。他们用有限可靠性类别与有限 RKHS 信号字典刻画这两类不确定性，并构造了一个固定的审计设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gaussian process bandits exploit similarities among configurations to optimize prompts, retrieval systems, and agent workflows. In these applications, however, inexpensive model-based evaluations can disagree with trusted task outcomes. We study selective verification when an action is chosen before a diagnostic is observed and trusted feedback is informative on an unknown set of diagnostic states. A finite reliability class and a finite RKHS signal dictionary describe these two sources of uncertainty. We construct a fixed audit design that com…
items.why_zh: 它把“何时该花钱做可信验证”形式化，直接关系到提示与智能体工作流优化的成本与可靠性。
items.why_en: It formalizes when to pay for trusted verification, directly affecting the cost and reliability of prompt and agent-workflow optimization.

items.title_zh: FETALFusion：面向多来源胎儿头部分割的分辨率感知状态空间建模
items.title_en: FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 由 2D 超声测量头围是评估胎儿生长的常规指标，自动化这一过程需要分割边界在单张扫描上也足够准确，而不只是平均表现好。作者提出 FETALFusion，一种双路径 CNN-Mamba 编码器-解码器，用于跨采集类型的胎儿头部分割：只在两个最高分辨率阶段做四方向状态空间扫描，瓶颈特征经过域特定的通道门控并在测试时取平均，同时加入弱关键点形状先验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17951v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly…
items.why_zh: 头围测量的自动化依赖单次扫描上的边界精度，该设计直接针对这一临床可靠性要求。
items.why_en: Automating head-circumference measurement hinges on per-scan boundary accuracy, which this design targets directly.

items.title_zh: 识破伪造还不够：医疗视觉语言模型在伪造证据下的"退步式谄媚"
items.title_en: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这项研究关注医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）的一种失效模式：即便模型最初给出了正确判断，只要用户附上一份方向相反的伪造处方等"证据"表示反对，模型往往会顺从地改口。作者将这种现象命名为"伪造证据下的退步式谄媚"（regressive sycophancy）——模型放弃原本正确的答案，向假文件妥协。研究选取四个开源 VLM，在 400 道 VQA-RAD 是/否问题上构造了 19,200 轮多轮对话，分别在附带和不附带伪造处方的条件下进行测试。该工作提示，医疗 AI 的安全性不能只看模型能否识别错误信息，更要看它在面对伪造材料施压时能否守住正确结论。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17989v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescripti…
items.why_zh: 在医疗场景中，模型因伪造文件而改掉正确诊断，可能直接造成临床风险。
items.why_en: In medical settings, a model that flips a correct diagnosis because of a fake document can directly create clinical risk.

items.title_zh: 目标越多反而越易识别：偏好与反馈在多目标最佳臂识别中的作用
items.title_en: When More Objectives Make Identification Easier: The Role of Preferences and Feedback
items.summary_zh: 最佳臂识别（BAI）的目标是用尽可能少的样本找到最优选项，以往研究多聚焦单一目标，而现实应用往往涉及多重评价标准，由此催生了多目标匪徒下的 BAI 问题。直觉上，多目标识别更难，因为学习器要在更高维的奖励空间中找出最优臂；但论文指出，额外的目标同时带来了更丰富的反馈，反而可能减少所需的探索。作者刻画了其中的权衡关系，说明目标数量、偏好信息与反馈结构如何共同影响识别难度与样本效率。该研究为多准则决策场景下的高效实验设计提供了理论依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18577v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Best-arm identification (BAI) aims to identify the optimal arm using as few samples as possible. While most existing work focuses on a single objective, many real-world applications involve multiple criteria, which motivates the study of BAI in multi-objective bandits. Intuitively, multi-objective identification seems harder, since the learner must identify optimal arms in a higher-dimensional reward space; however, the additional objectives also provide richer feedback that can reduce the required exploration. In this paper, we characterize wh…
items.why_zh: 它颠覆了"多目标必然更难"的直觉，为多准则场景下的高效决策提供了理论指导。
items.why_en: It overturns the intuition that more objectives must be harder, offering theory for efficient decision-making under multiple criteria.

items.title_zh: ACCRUE：面向机器人基础模型的持续离线策略强化学习
items.title_en: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 强化学习后训练能让机器人基础模型（RFM）超越示教数据的局限，但真实部署还要求模型在高效学习新任务的同时不遗忘已有能力。现有基于视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的持续学习方法虽能缓解遗忘，却依赖在线策略更新，前向迁移能力有限；离线策略方法提升了单任务样本效率，却未解决跨任务的学习者持久性问题。为此，作者提出 ACCRUE——一个持续离线策略强化学习框架，通过携带轻量级组件在任务序列中保持并迁移所学行为，兼顾新任务适应与旧技能保留。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweig…
items.why_zh: 持续学习能力是机器人基础模型从实验室走向长期真实部署的关键瓶颈。
items.why_en: Continual learning is a key bottleneck for deploying robot foundation models in long-term real-world settings.

items.title_zh: 合并排行榜没告诉你的事：微服务根因分析基准中方法比较的范围与来源审计
items.title_en: What a Pooled Leaderboard Does Not Say: Auditing the Scope and Provenance of Method Comparisons in Microservice RCA Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 微服务根因分析（RCA）的离线基准通常把多个应用上的得分合并成一个总分来给方法排名，但这种"合并领先"掩盖了两件事：该优势究竟在哪些系统上成立，以及这个分数是如何产生的。作者在三个公开基准族（OpenRCA、RCAEval 和 PetShop）上对两者同时展开审计，在 11 个子系统以及其中三个应用的第二个版本上，按记录的配置运行了 16 种方法的官方实现。研究发现，已发表方法之间的合并排名未必在每个子系统上都成立，提醒研究者在解读基准榜单时需要更细致的范围与可复现性说明。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.29159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Offline benchmarks for microservice root cause analysis (RCA) rank methods by a score pooled over several applications, and a pooled lead leaves two things unstated: on which of the systems it holds, and how the score was produced. We audit both on three public benchmark families (OpenRCA, RCAEval, and PetShop), running the released implementations of 16 methods under recorded configurations on 11 subsystems and on a second release of three of the applications. Whether a pooled lead between published methods holds on every subsystem is decide…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了基准榜单可能误导人们对方法进展的判断，强调了可复现与分系统评估的必要性。
items.why_en: It shows how pooled leaderboards can mislead progress assessments, underscoring the need for reproducible, per-system evaluation.

items.title_zh: JaxAHT：面向临时协作（Ad Hoc Teamwork）的 JAX 开源库
items.title_en: JaxAHT: A JAX-Based Library for Ad Hoc Teamwork
items.summary_zh: 随着自主智能体日益普及，它们必须能与此前从未见过的伙伴（例如人类）协同行动，这一挑战被形式化为"临时协作"（Ad Hoc Teamwork，AHT），并已吸引大量研究。然而该领域进展受制于三点：AHT 研究全流程的计算开销过高、缺乏标准化的基准实现，以及缺少多样化且经过验证的协作队友测试集。为此，作者推出 JaxAHT——首个基于 JAX 的开源库，旨在加速 AHT 的研究迭代，并缓解上述基础设施层面的障碍。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13716v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As autonomous agents are increasingly deployed, they must be able to coordinate with previously unseen agents, such as humans. This challenge has been formalized as Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT), and has attracted a substantial body of research. However, progress has been hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. This work introduces JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelera…
items.why_zh: 标准化、低成本的研究工具是推动智能体与人类顺畅协作研究的基础设施。
items.why_en: Standardized, low-cost tooling is infrastructure for advancing research on agents coordinating with humans.

items.title_zh: MS-Exam-Gen：面向多发性硬化MRI知识评测的自动化基准构建工具包
items.title_en: MS-Exam-Gen: An Automatic Benchmark Construction Toolkit for Evaluating LLMs on Multiple Sclerosis-MRI Imaging Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 生物医学大模型评测需要对细分、演进且需溯源的专业知识进行可审计的考察，多发性硬化MRI（MS-MRI）正是一个高风险测试场景：正确推理要求掌握最新诊断标准、标准化的采集与报告规范、纵向随访概念、病灶形态学以及疑难模仿病变的识别。作者提出 MS-Exam-Gen，一个可复现的框架，用于构建和审计基于文本的单选题（MCQ）评测集，从而自动化地为上述 MS-MRI 知识维度生成考题。该工具旨在让生物医学 LLM 的专科知识评估更透明、更可追溯。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06170v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ…
items.why_zh: 它为高风险医学专科知识的LLM评测提供了可复现、可审计的自动化基准构建方式。
items.why_en: It offers a reproducible, auditable way to build benchmarks for high-stakes subspecialty medical knowledge in LLMs.

items.title_zh: 复杂查询问答真的复杂吗？
items.title_en: Is Complex Query Answering Really Complex?
items.summary_zh: 知识图谱上的复杂查询问答（CQA）正作为一项具有挑战性的推理任务受到越来越多关注。本文指出，当前 CQA 基准可能并没有想象中那么复杂，其构建方式扭曲了我们对领域进展的认知。例如作者发现，在这些基准中，大部分查询（某些查询类型中高达 98%）都可以被归约为更简单的问题，比如只需预测一条链接的链接预测。当把查询简化到这种程度后，当前最先进 CQA 模型的性能会显著下降，说明基准的难度设定与真实推理能力之间存在落差。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2410.12537v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Complex query answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs (KGs) is gaining momentum as a challenging reasoning task. In this paper, we show that the current benchmarks for CQA might not be as complex as we think, as the way they are built distorts our perception of progress in this field. For example, we find that in these benchmarks, most queries (up to 98% for some query types) can be reduced to simpler problems, e.g., link prediction, where only one link needs to be predicted. The performance of state-of-the-art CQA models decreases signific…
items.why_zh: 若基准可被归约，那么排行榜上的"复杂推理"进展可能被高估。
items.why_en: If benchmarks can be reduced, reported progress on "complex reasoning" may be overstated.

items.title_zh: 医疗领域的开放基础模型：生成式AI个性化处方面临的挑战、悖论与机遇
items.title_en: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
items.summary_zh: 在专有大语言模型取得成功的带动下，学界对开发开放、非专有的 LLM 与 AI 基础模型（AIFM）兴趣日增，以支持学术、科研和非商业场景中的透明应用，这类模型在医疗领域潜力巨大。本文提供了面向临床任务的开放 LLM 与 AIFM 的最新综述与分类体系，并在此基础上对开放权重 LLM 进行了实证评估，考察其在个性化处方任务上的表现。研究同时讨论了开放模型在医疗落地中面临的挑战与悖论，以及生成式 AI 驱动的个性化处方所带来的机遇。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.04356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications. Open models have substantial potential to improve healthcare applications. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and a taxonomy of state-of-the-art open LLMs and AIFMs for clinical tasks. In addition, we empirically evaluate open-weight LLMs on a personalized-prescription task a…
items.why_zh: 开放模型能否在处方这类高风险临床任务中可靠落地，直接关系医疗AI的透明与普及。
items.why_en: Whether open models can be trusted for high-stakes clinical tasks like prescribing shapes the transparency and reach of medical AI.

items.title_zh: 从视觉事件生成自然语言：最新进展与关键开放问题
items.title_en: Natural Language Generation from Visual Events: State-of-the-Art and Key Open Questions
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文（arXiv:2502.13034v4，替换版本）指出，近年来视觉grounded的自然语言处理研究大量聚焦于图像或视频内容描述等多模态现实场景，但相对较少有人研究这些场景中不同模态之间互动的性质与程度。作者主张，凡是处理“从图像或帧序列生成自然语言”的任务，实际上都属于一个更广泛、更一般的问题——对模态之间复杂交互的建模。文章梳理了该方向的最新研究现状，并提出了若干关键开放问题，呼吁学界更系统地研究模态间交互本身，而非只关注最终生成效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.13034v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In recent years, a substantial body of work in visually grounded natural language processing has focused on real-life multimodal scenarios such as describing content depicted in images or videos. However, comparatively less attention has been devoted to studying the nature and degree of interaction between the different modalities in these scenarios. In this paper, we argue that any task dealing with natural language generation from sequences of images or frames is an instance of the broader, more general problem of modeling the intrica…
items.why_zh: 它把“视觉到语言”的各类任务统一到模态交互建模这一框架下，为后续研究指明了被忽视的方向。
items.why_en: It reframes diverse vision-to-language tasks as instances of cross-modal interaction modeling, pointing to an underexplored research direction.

items.title_zh: 面向 Java 项目的调用链感知 LLM 测试生成方法 CAT
items.title_en: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects
items.summary_zh: 该论文（arXiv:2604.22046v2，替换版本）关注用大语言模型生成项目级单元测试。作者指出，现有最先进方法主要依赖执行路径信息来构建提示词，而面对类间依赖丰富、调用链深、对象初始化复杂的复杂软件系统时，这种信息往往不够。为此他们提出 CAT，一种调用链感知的 LLM 测试生成方法，显式地把调用链与依赖上下文纳入提示构建，以更好地应对复杂项目中的测试生成需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.22046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for generating project-level unit tests. However, existing state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on execution-path information to guide prompt construction, which is often insufficient for complex software systems with rich inter-class dependencies, deep call chains, and intricate object initialization requirements. In this paper, we present CAT, a novel call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach that explicitly incorporates call-chain and dependency context…
items.why_zh: 通过把调用链与依赖上下文引入提示词，它有望提升复杂 Java 项目中自动生成单元测试的可用性。
items.why_en: By injecting call-chain and dependency context into prompts, it aims to make automated unit test generation viable for complex Java codebases.

items.title_zh: SIDScope：生成式推荐中语义 ID 接口的诊断资源
items.title_en: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
items.summary_zh: 在生成式推荐中，语义 ID 分词器为目录中的物品分配编码序列，生成式推荐模型预测这些编码并再解析回具体物品。当复用已发布的映射时，需要检查其编码组织方式、物品解析能力，以及在刷新后与现有模型的兼容性。SIDScope 通过带源码追踪的适配器、映射诊断、候选检索测试和生成轨迹分析来完成这些检查。其清单包含来自 7 个分词器家族、覆盖 Amazon 与 Yelp 的 9 个导出项，其中含 8 条可执行路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Semantic ID tokenizers assign code sequences to catalog items, which generative recommenders predict and resolve back to items. Reusing a released mapping requires checking its code organization, item resolution, and compatibility with an existing model after a refresh. SIDScope provides these checks through source traced adapters, mapping diagnostics, candidate retrieval tests, and generated trace analysis. Its inventory contains nine exports from seven tokenizer families across Amazon and Yelp, including eight executable routes and on…
items.why_zh: 它为复用语义 ID 映射提供了可执行的诊断工具，有助于生成式推荐系统的可复现性与兼容性验证。
items.why_en: It provides executable diagnostics for reusing semantic-ID mappings, supporting reproducibility and compatibility checks in generative recommendation.

items.title_zh: 当上下文误导模型：LLM 的管辖判断与上下文学习
items.title_en: When Context Misleads: In-context Learning with Jurisdiction in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）已成为现代大模型部署的基石，但论文指出既有 ICL 后训练方法存在一个关键盲点：它们擅长从示例中抽取模式，却常忽视“上下文权威性”，即判断上下文信息是否应当主导最终答案的能力。为衡量这一能力，作者提出 FakeContextBench，其中包含横跨七个领域的伪科学主张。对商用与开源模型的评测显示，大规模预训练（摘要在此处截断）会影响模型对上下文权威性的判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.27603v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a cornerstone of modern LLM deployment. However, existing ICL post-training methods have a critical blind spot: they excel at extracting patterns from demonstrations while often neglecting context authority, the ability to determine whether contextual information should govern the final answer. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FakeContextBench, which contains pseudoscientific claims across seven domains. Our evaluation of commercial and open-source models shows that large-scale pre-training…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了模型容易被错误上下文带偏的风险，并提供了衡量“该不该听上下文”这一能力的基准。
items.why_en: It exposes how models can be misled by unreliable context and offers a benchmark for judging when context should govern an answer.

items.title_zh: SoFT：面向可泛化 LLM 微调的软目标方法
items.title_en: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 蒸馏可以让“学生”语言模型从专家“教师”处获得新能力，但要把多教师、多领域的示范知识整合进同一个学生模型仍然困难。论文研究这一设定下的监督微调（SFT）：学生需习得多样能力，同时保持超出训练任务的泛化性。实验显示，不同 SFT 方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在不同的权衡，这促使作者提出更显式的协同（摘要在此处截断）方案，即 SoFT 软目标方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit co…
items.why_zh: 它针对多教师蒸馏中“学得会”与“泛化好”的矛盾，提出了改善可泛化性的微调思路。
items.why_en: It targets the tension between absorbing diverse teacher knowledge and generalizing beyond training tasks in LLM fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: Ready2Blend：把自然语言指令转化为可组合的对齐提示
items.title_en: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
items.summary_zh: 持续对齐要求大模型在不断适应新需求的同时不遗忘既已获得的行为。自然语言指令灵活且可组合，但只能提供间接控制；后训练则适配更强，代价是反复更新参数。为此作者提出 Ready2Blend，把自然语言的灵活性与学习到的对齐结合起来：AlignFormer 将每条需求映射为一个定长对齐提示，存入模块化的提示库，而主干模型与既有提示保持不变。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39365v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts rema…
items.why_zh: 它以模块化提示库的方式实现持续对齐，在避免遗忘的同时免去反复更新模型参数的开销。
items.why_en: It enables continual alignment through a modular prompt bank, avoiding forgetting without repeatedly updating model parameters.

items.title_zh: 追踪语言习得中的形态、语义与分化过程
items.title_en: Tracing Morphology, Semantics, and Divergence in Language Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 理解大语言模型的语言习得动态，对于揭示统计表征如何演化为结构化语言能力至关重要，但既有研究多聚焦完全训练好的模型，对中间训练阶段的发展轨迹探讨不足。该论文利用开源模型（如 Pythia 与 OLMo）的中间检查点，在 teacher-forcing 评测下系统考察语言习得在整个训练过程中的变化，追踪形态、语义等能力以及不同模型之间的分化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the dynamics of language acquisition in Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for uncovering how statistical representations evolve into structured linguistic capabilities. However, most existing studies focus primarily on fully trained models, leaving the developmental trajectory across intermediate training stages largely underexplored. In this work, we leverage intermediate checkpoints from open-source models (e.g., Pythia and OLMo) under teacher-forcing evaluation to systematically investigate language acquisition across train…
items.why_zh: 通过中间检查点观察能力涌现过程，有助于理解大模型语言能力是如何随训练逐步形成的。
items.why_en: By tracing intermediate checkpoints, it sheds light on how linguistic capabilities emerge over the course of LLM training.

items.title_zh: 面向序贯筛选的历史特征残差适配
items.title_en: Historical-Feature Residual Adaptation for Sequential Screening
items.summary_zh: 序贯筛选策略必须在固定实验预算下有效利用所获得的反馈。论文研究“获取时刻的残差适配”：用固定的历史特征构建一个小的排序修正项，并锚定在反馈揭示之前记录的基准分数上。该接口接受一个以历史为条件的评分器与候选特征表；其主要实现是在保留预训练模型的前提下，为 AssayFormer 的十维表示增加 64 个历史方向。作者在 20 个官方（数据集，摘要在此处截断）上进行了回顾性评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential screening policies must use acquired feedback effectively under a fixed experiment budget. We study acquisition-time residual adaptation: a small ranking correction built from fixed historical features and anchored to base scores recorded before feedback is revealed. The interface accepts a history-conditioned scorer and a candidate feature table; its primary instantiation augments AssayFormer's ten-dimensional representation with 64 historical directions while retaining the pretrained model. In retrospective evaluation on 20 official-…
items.why_zh: 它提出在不动预训练模型的前提下用历史特征做轻量残差修正，为预算受限的序贯筛选提供了高效适配手段。
items.why_en: It offers a lightweight, history-based residual correction that adapts sequential screening policies without retraining the base model under tight budgets.

items.title_zh: HankelKANet：基于物理启发的 Hankel 卷积实现轻量级路径损耗估计
items.title_en: HankelKANet: Lightweight Path Loss Estimation via Physics-Inspired Hankel Convolution
items.summary_zh: 路径损耗（PL）估计对无线网络规划与优化至关重要。论文提出 HankelKANet，一种轻量级、物理启发的路径损耗估计网络，把电磁传播特性结构化地嵌入神经网络架构中。模型以单个残差 UNet 为主干，将城市布局特征与卷积型 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）结合，卷积核由零阶与一阶 Hankel 函数的径向幅度参数化，从而在结构层面体现电磁传播规律。该研究旨在让路径损耗估计既保持轻量，又具备物理一致性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate path loss (PL) estimation is essential for wireless network planning and optimization. This paper proposes HankelKANet, a lightweight physics-inspired network for PL estimation that structurally embeds electromagnetic propagation characteristics into the neural architecture. Built on a single residual UNet backbone, the proposed model integrates urban layout features with a convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network(KAN). Specifically, the convolutional kernels are parameterized by the radial amplitudes of the zeroth- and first-order Hankel…
items.why_zh: 把电磁传播物理规律直接嵌入轻量网络结构，有望提升无线网络规划中路径损耗估计的精度与泛化能力。
items.why_en: Embedding electromagnetic propagation physics directly into a lightweight architecture could improve both accuracy and generalization in wireless network planning.

items.title_zh: 诊断并纠正可验证指令遵循中的奖励黑客问题
items.title_en: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
items.summary_zh: 可验证的指令遵循评测强调输出是否满足约束，却可能忽略回答是否真正回应了底层请求，形成评测盲区。作者发现，前沿模型即使几乎没有实质性答案内容，也能凭约束满足拿到满分。若把同一套验证器标准直接用作训练奖励，就会诱发奖励黑客：公开模型检查点在经过基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）后，约束满足率上升，但回答质量反而下降。论文进而提出诊断与纠正方法以应对这一失配（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To ad…
items.why_zh: 揭示可验证奖励训练中约束满足与回答质量脱节的隐患，对 RLVR 的训练与评测设计具有警示意义。
items.why_en: It exposes a hidden mismatch between constraint satisfaction and true response quality in RLVR, warning both training and evaluation design.

items.title_zh: 基于序贯学习的物理信息神经网络用于功率变换器参数估计
items.title_en: Sequential Learning-Based Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling for Parameter Estimation on a Power Converter
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一种分阶段训练的物理信息神经网络（PINN），用于从时域数据中辨识直流 Buck 变换器的电感、电容与寄生电阻。梯度按 L→C→rL→rC 的顺序逐步释放，该顺序由灵敏度分析得出。五阶段方案可将电感与电容的估计误差控制在 5% 以内、串联等效电阻误差控制在 10% 以内；三阶段变体在保持同等精度的同时快 11%。8^4 析因扫描进一步表明，训练后的 PINN 在四个元件同时出现 8% 扰动时仍保持准确。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A staged physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for identifying the inductance, capacitance and parasitic resistances of a DC buck converter from time-domain data. Gradients are released in the order of L to C to rL to rC, a sequence derived from sensitivity analysis. The five-stage schedule recovers L and C to within 5% and the series ESR to 10%, while a three-stage variant attains the same accuracy 11% faster. An 84 factorial sweep confirms that the trained PINN remains accurate for simultaneous 8% perturbations of all four componen…
items.why_zh: 把物理规律与分阶段训练结合，为电力电子器件参数辨识提供了精度与效率兼顾的数据驱动方案。
items.why_en: Combining physics constraints with staged training offers a data-driven route to accurate, efficient power-electronics parameter identification.

items.title_zh: 在带可验证奖励的强化学习中，动量究竟何时有用？
items.title_en: When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?
items.summary_zh: 动量是加速凸优化和训练大语言模型的经典工具，但近期实证研究对一阶动量在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中的价值提出了质疑。作者用带偏差校正指数移动平均（EMA）动量的赌博机形式刻画 RLVR，其中 EMA 系数 β 控制过去梯度权重的衰减速度。在策略梯度可精确计算的设定下，论文给出关于动量作用的理论结论（摘要在此截断），以厘清动量在什么条件下带来收益。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $\beta$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increas…
items.why_zh: 为 RLVR 中是否以及何时使用动量提供理论依据，有助于改进大模型强化学习后训练的效率。
items.why_en: It gives theoretical grounding for whether and when momentum helps in RLVR, informing more efficient post-training of large models.

items.title_zh: 使用卷积神经网络检测马铃薯叶片病害
items.title_en: Detection of Potato Plant Leaf Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks
items.summary_zh: 马铃薯是埃塞俄比亚重要的粮食安全作物，但其生产受到叶部病害影响，尤其是早疫病与晚疫病。本研究构建了一个轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN），将马铃薯叶片分为健康、早疫病、晚疫病三类。模型使用 PlantVillage 数据集中的 2,215 张图像训练，并在来自埃塞俄比亚 Awi 地区 Banja 马铃薯农场的 247 张独立田间图像上评估，在 PlantVillage 上取得 99% 级别的高准确率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Potato is an important food-security crop in Ethiopia, but its production is affected by foliar diseases, particularly early blight and late blight. This study develops a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify potato leaves into three categories: healthy, early blight, and late blight. The proposed model was trained using 2,215 images from the PlantVillage dataset and evaluated on an independent field dataset containing 247 images collected from potato farms in Banja, Awi Zone, Ethiopia. On PlantVillage, the model achieved 99.…
items.why_zh: 面向小农户场景的轻量模型与真实田间数据验证，展示了 CNN 在粮食安全作物病害早期筛查中的实用价值。
items.why_en: A lightweight model validated on real field data shows the practical value of CNNs for early disease screening in a food-security crop.

items.title_zh: 从复制到组合：语言模型如何发展出上下文学习能力
items.title_en: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
items.summary_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）让语言模型能根据提示中的指令与示例调整行为，但仅看准确率无法揭示上下文信息究竟如何控制其预测。作者设计了一种受控诊断方法，把“复制邻近示例的答案”与“跨提示整合信息”区分开来。在 17 个模型上的结果显示：约三分之一的模型偏好复制来的答案，少数模型表现游移，其余模型则偏向符合规则的答案，而后者对应更高的准确率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19113v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer, which goes with higher accuracy and wi…
items.why_zh: 厘清模型 ICL 更依赖复制还是规则整合，有助于理解并改进提示设计与泛化评估。
items.why_en: Clarifying whether in-context learning relies on copying or rule composition helps improve prompt design and generalization evaluation.

items.title_zh: 几何补充下的策略性排队学习：从赌博机到系统
items.title_en: Learning in Strategic Queuing with Geometric Recharge: From Bandits to Systems
items.summary_zh: 论文研究排队系统中的数据包路由：队列被建模为自私、短视的智能体，用无遗憾（no-regret）学习算法在服务率未知的服务器之间做选择。为刻画数据中心常见的小缓冲区，作者假设每台服务器只有单包缓冲区；即便如此小的缓冲也已体现排队特征——路由器可在已接收数据包仍在服务时利用多台服务器，而数据包可能占用服务器多轮，使后续服务与学习复杂化。论文先分析单队列路由，再扩展到系统层面（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19179v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study packet routing in queuing systems where queues act as selfish, myopic agents that use no-regret learning algorithms to select servers with unknown service rates. To model the small buffers used in data centers, we assume that each server has a single-packet buffer. Even such a tiny buffer already captures the features of buffering: routers can exploit multiple servers while accepted packets remain in service, but packets can occupy servers for multiple rounds, complicating future service and learning. We first analyze a single queue ro…
items.why_zh: 把无遗憾学习与排队博弈结合，为数据中心路由与多智能体资源竞争的算法设计提供理论视角。
items.why_en: Bridging no-regret learning and queuing games offers theoretical insight for data-center routing and multi-agent resource competition.

items.title_zh: TopicMerge：分而治之的主题建模方法
items.title_en: TopicMerge: A Divide and Conquer Approach to Topic Modeling
items.summary_zh: 近期主题建模分化为两条路线：一是高效但标准聚类指标上常被超越的嵌入方法，二是聚类性能达到最先进水平、却计算代价高昂且可扩展性差的大语言模型（LLM）方法。论文提出 TopicMerge，一种多阶段流水线，力图弥合两者差距，同时实现最先进的聚类性能与计算效率。其做法是先以某种方式结合两类方法的优势，再形成“分而治之”的主题建模框架（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19323v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advancements in topic modeling have split into two main paths: efficient embedding-based methods that offer scalability but are often outperformed on standard clustering metrics, and Large Language Model (LLM) approaches that achieve state-of-the-art clustering performance but at the cost of prohibitive computational expense and poor scalability. This paper introduces TopicMerge, a novel multi-stage pipeline that bridges these approaches to achieve both state-of-the-art clustering performance and computational efficiency. TopicMerge firs…
items.why_zh: 试图在 LLM 级聚类质量与嵌入方法的效率之间取得平衡，对大规模主题建模的工程落地有直接意义。
items.why_en: Balancing LLM-level clustering quality with embedding-method efficiency has direct relevance for large-scale topic modeling in practice.

items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 神经算子的带内全双工数字自干扰消除
items.title_en: Digital Self-Interference Cancellation for In-Band Full-Duplex Systems Based on Transformer Neural Operators
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文把数字域自干扰消除重新表述为一个“算子学习”问题，并提出基于 Transformer 神经算子的方法。在带内全双工无线电中，经过被动抑制和模拟消除之后，数字域自干扰消除依然必不可少，而当期望信号相对残余自干扰较强时难度尤其大。在这一区间，传统迭代式数字消除器要用被期望信号污染的接收样本来更新系数，性能可能显著退化。论文将这一问题重构为算子学习，以绕开上述局限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19490v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Digital-domain self-interference cancellation is essential in in-band full-duplex radios after passive suppression and analog cancellation. It is particularly challenging when the desired signal is strong relative to the residual self-interference. In this regime, conventional iterative digital cancellers update their coefficients from desired-signal-contaminated received samples and may suffer substantial performance degradation. This paper reformulates digital-domain self-interference cancellation as an operator-learning problem. The proposed…
items.why_zh: 数字自干扰消除是带内全双工提升频谱效率的关键瓶颈，算子学习提供了不同于传统迭代方案的新思路。
items.why_en: Digital self-interference cancellation is a key bottleneck for in-band full-duplex radios, and operator learning offers an alternative to conventional iterative cancellers.

items.title_zh: 你签名的不是你运行的：量化 LLM 供应链中的可验证性缺口
items.title_en: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains
items.summary_zh: 论文指出大模型供应链存在“可验证性缺口”：模型签名通常只认证发布时的全精度权重 W，但用户实际运行的却是量化产物 Q，而当前的信息披露无法唯一确定这一转换过程。作者把非环境输入与执行环境 E 区分开来，并提出“独立可验证率”（IVR），即第三方能够逐比特重新推导的比例——据作者所知这是此前未被测量过的量。研究在该指标上考察了 Hugging Face 上按下载量最热门的 200 个 GGUF 仓库。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19498v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Model signing authenticates the full-precision weights W an LLM is released with, yet users run a quantized artifact Q whose producing transformation is not uniquely determined under current disclosure. We separate the non-environment inputs from the execution environment E and measure a quantity that, to our knowledge, has not been measured before: the Independent Verifiability Rate (IVR), the fraction of a popularity-sampled GGUF ecosystem that a third party can re-derive bit-for-bit. Across the 200 most-downloaded Hugging Face GGUF repositor…
items.why_zh: 若签名权重与实际运行的量化模型无法对应，模型来源可信与可复现性的基础就会被动摇。
items.why_en: If signed weights cannot be tied to the quantized model actually run, the basis for provenance trust and reproducibility is undermined.

items.title_zh: SAM3RL：用强化学习控制记忆的视觉目标跟踪
items.title_en: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
items.summary_zh: SAM 3 是图像与视频分割的基础模型，在视觉目标跟踪上达到当前最优水平。其跟踪器继承自 SAM 2，用记忆库保存历史帧信息，并以简单的先进先出（FIFO）规则进行管理，从而在复杂视频中保持时序一致性。近期一些方法为 SAM 2 设计了手工记忆更新规则，各自针对干扰物、遮挡或目标运动等特定失效模式，但这些收益的迁移性有限。本文提出 SAM3RL，用强化学习来控制记忆，而不是依赖手工规则。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.19931v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the st…
items.why_zh: 用学习到的策略替代手工设计的记忆规则，有望让跟踪器在不同失效模式下更通用、更鲁棒。
items.why_en: Replacing hand-crafted memory rules with a learned policy could make tracking more general and robust across failure modes.

items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 路由的相关性感知情境赌博与代理奖励
items.title_en: Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing
items.summary_zh: 论文研究一类情境赌博问题：各“臂”之间存在相关性，同时可以获得由机器学习模型产生的代理奖励信号，其动机来自大语言模型路由等应用场景。与仅依赖赌博反馈、并假设各臂条件独立的情境赌博不同，该设定允许上下文相关的臂间相关性，以及可能带噪或设定错误的辅助奖励信息。作者提出了两种互补设计的算法，以利用这类代理奖励。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.09015v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A…
items.why_zh: LLM 路由需要在有限反馈下选择模型，可迁移的相关性与代理奖励设计直接关系到路由效率与成本。
items.why_en: LLM routing must pick models under limited feedback, so exploiting correlation and surrogate rewards directly affects routing efficiency and cost.

items.title_zh: tidyHEBO：提升异方差进化贝叶斯优化的稳健性
items.title_en: tidyHEBO: Improving the Robustness of Heteroskedastic Evolutionary Bayesian Optimization
items.summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化广泛用于昂贵的黑箱优化问题。论文强调，方法上的进展往往聚焦于单个组件，但实际性能取决于这些组件如何协同工作。作者提出 tidyHEBO：它联合学习输出变形（output warping）与高斯过程参数，在原始目标尺度上评估采集函数，并在进化搜索过程中保留有前景的新候选点。在 Olympus 基准上，tidyHEBO 在参与评估的方法中排名第一。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.10669v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bayesian optimization is widely used for expensive black-box optimization problems. While methodological advances often focus on individual components, practical performance depends on how these components work together. We present tidyHEBO, a Bayesian optimization model. tidyHEBO jointly learns output warping and Gaussian-process parameters, evaluates acquisition functions on the original objective scale, and preserves promising novel candidates throughout evolutionary search. On the Olympus benchmark, tidyHEBO ranked first among the evaluat…
items.why_zh: 在昂贵的黑箱优化中，组件协同而非单点创新往往决定实际效果，该工作给出了更稳健的组合方案。
items.why_en: In expensive black-box optimization, component interaction rather than isolated novelty often drives real-world performance, and this work offers a more robust combination.

items.title_zh: 用真实感修补扰动提升视觉 XAI 的解释质量
items.title_en: Inpainting Insights: Elevating Visual XAI with Photorealistic Perturbations
items.summary_zh: 随着最先进机器学习模型日益复杂，其行为越来越难以解释，可解释人工智能（XAI）因此快速发展。在众多方法中，基于扰动的方法占据重要地位：通过系统性地改动输入特征，衡量其对模型预测的影响。对于图像数据，传统扰动技术通常用预定义颜色等替换像素值，但这类做法存在明显局限。本文提出以基于图像修补（inpainting）的真实感扰动来替代传统方案，从而提升视觉解释的质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.15482v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The increasing complexity of state-of-the-art machine learning models has made their behavior progressively harder to interpret, spurring rapid advancements in the field of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Among many methods proposed, perturbation-based approaches play a major role. By systematically altering (perturbing) input features, these approaches measure the impact on the model's predictions. For image data, traditional perturbation techniques, often involve replacing pixel values e.g., with a pre-defined color. However, suc…
items.why_zh: 扰动方式本身会引入伪影并扭曲解释结果，更真实的扰动有望让视觉解释更可信。
items.why_en: Perturbation choices can introduce artifacts and distort explanations, so more realistic perturbations can make visual explanations more trustworthy.

items.title_zh: EMG-FM-Bench：肌电基础模型迁移与适配的综合基准
items.title_en: EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography
items.summary_zh: 基础模型正越来越多地被用于通用时间序列和生理信号，但它们向下游生理任务的可迁移性仍缺乏理解。这一问题在肌电（EMG）上尤为棘手：信号分布会随用户、传感配置、采集硬件以及下游任务的不同而大幅变化。为此，作者提出 EMG-FM-Bench，一个用于系统研究基础模型在 EMG 上迁移与适配的基准，统一了 20 个公开数据集。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06450v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets wit…
items.why_zh: 缺少统一评测就难以判断基础模型在肌电等高度异质生理信号上是否真正可迁移。
items.why_en: Without unified evaluation it is hard to tell whether foundation models truly transfer to highly heterogeneous physiological signals such as EMG.

items.title_zh: 在 bf16 转换中丢失：导出过程可能回退三值模型的大部分低学习率改动
items.title_en: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
items.summary_zh: BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E、BitCPM 等三值语言模型在微调时使用更高精度的潜在权重，部署时则导出为三值编码；按各实验室公开的流程，导出前会先把潜在权重转换为 bf16。作者审计了三个实验室的这一流程，发现在已发布的检查点中，对发布版潜在权重做 fp32 量化所得到的编码与部署编码并不一致：Falcon-E 和 BitCPM 的不一致比例为 0.83%–1.77%，BitNet 2B-4T 为 1.530%。论文标题进一步指出，这种导出过程可能回退大部分低学习率带来的编码改动。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07853v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lan…
items.why_zh: 若导出步骤悄悄覆盖微调带来的改动，三值模型的可复现性与发布权重的可信度都会受到质疑。
items.why_en: If the export step silently overwrites fine-tuning gains, reproducibility and the trustworthiness of released ternary weights come into question.

items.title_zh: 超越规模：梯度如何塑造大语言模型的剪枝决策
items.title_en: Beyond Size: How Gradients Shape Pruning Decisions in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了一种面向预训练大语言模型的新型稀疏化剪枝方法——基于梯度的语言模型剪枝器（GBLM-Pruner）。作者指出，此前的幅度剪枝、SparseGPT 和 Wanda 等方法要么只看权重，要么把权重与激活值结合来决定稀疏结构，却忽视了预训练 LLM 中蕴含信息的梯度。GBLM-Pruner 将梯度信息纳入剪枝决策，为在数十亿参数模型上压缩权重而不明显损伤性能提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2311.04902v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters are prime targets for network pruning, which removes some model weights without hurting performance. Prior approaches such as magnitude pruning, SparseGPT, and Wanda either concentrated solely on weights or integrated weights with activations for sparsity. However, they overlooked the informative gradients derived from pretrained LLMs. In this paper, we present a novel sparsity-centric pruning method for pretrained LLMs, termed Gradient-based Language Model Pruner (GBLM-Pruner). G…
items.why_zh: 在参数动辄数十亿的大模型上，剪枝是降低推理成本的关键手段，而把梯度纳入剪枝决策可能带来更优的稀疏结构与性能折中。
items.why_en: Pruning is key to cutting inference costs for billion-parameter LLMs, and using gradients may yield better sparsity decisions and accuracy trade-offs than weight- or activation-only methods.

items.title_zh: 我们离真正的自动化科研还有多远？
items.title_en: How Far Are We From True Auto-Research?
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，近期的自动科研系统虽已能产出完整论文，但“可行”不等于“优质”，学界仍缺乏对智能体生成论文质量的系统评估。为此作者提出 ResearchArena：一个极简脚手架，让现成智能体（使用 Opus 4.6 的 Claude Code、使用 GPT-5.4 的 Codex、使用 K2.5 的 Kimi Code）仅在轻量指导下自行完成选题、实验、写作与自我改进的完整科研闭环。实验覆盖 13 个计算机科学种子课题，每个智能体各跑 3 次，以此衡量自动化科研的真实水平。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.19156v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent auto-research systems can produce complete papers, but feasibility is not the same as quality, and the field still lacks a systematic study of how good agent-generated papers actually are. We introduce ResearchArena, a minimal scaffold that lets off-the-shelf agents (Claude Code using Opus 4.6, Codex using GPT-5.4, and Kimi Code using K2.5) carry out the full research loop themselves (ideation, experimentation, paper writing, self-refinement) under only lightweight guidance. Across 13 computer science seeds and 3 trials per agent…
items.why_zh: 它以统一基准量化了“AI 自动做科研”的真实水平，为判断智能体科研能力是否可信提供了急需的证据。
items.why_en: It provides a common benchmark for how good agent-generated research really is, offering much-needed evidence on the credibility of automated science.

items.title_zh: 减少循环次数会消除循环深度语言模型的拒答行为
items.title_en: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
items.summary_zh: 循环深度语言模型会连续多次复用同一组权重块，重复次数（即“循环数”）在模型运行时而非训练时决定，部署方可以选择跑更少的循环以降低成本、提升速度。一篇 arXiv 新研究（arXiv:2610.15218）发现，减少循环次数会让这类模型变得更不安全，而且安全性的损失幅度超过研究中测量的任何其他能力损失。作者考察了四个已发布的 Ouro 检查点以及 Huginn-0125：在训练深度的一半上运行，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 仍能解出 GSM8K 数学题中的 0.692，但拒答行为随之消失。这提示为了省算力而调低的推理配置，可能悄悄移除了模型的安全护栏。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems,…
items.why_zh: 循环数是部署时可调的参数，追求更低成本的推理配置可能在无人察觉的情况下削弱模型的安全拒答能力。
items.why_en: Loop count is a deployment-time knob, so cost-cutting inference settings may silently strip away a model's safety refusals.

items.title_zh: AgentStripes：面向 AI 智能体的证据分级成熟度模型
items.title_en: AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 现有基准只能说明 AI 智能体在某套任务上“能做什么”，却无法回答某个已发布版本是否配备了使其可靠、安全、可观测的工程控制，以及这些控制有多强的证据支撑。为此研究者提出 AgentStripes，一个证据分级的智能体成熟度模型：定义 0 到 7 个“条纹”等级、12 个过程域共 40 项能力，以及三道关卡（基础、安全、证明）——无论分数多高，只要未过关卡就会被卡在当前等级；每项适用能力还用 E0 到 E5 的证据等级标注其验证强度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability re…
items.why_zh: 它把“能不能做”与“是否被工程化地做对并有证据支撑”区分开来，为智能体发布提供了可审计的成熟度标尺。
items.why_en: It separates capability from engineered, evidenced reliability, giving agent releases an auditable maturity yardstick.

items.title_zh: GPT 系大模型如何表征心理健康污名：AI 估计与人类感知在性别群体间的差距
items.title_en: AI Representations of Mental Health Stigma: Quantifying the Gap Between AI Estimations and Human Perceptions Across Gender Groups Using GPT-Based LLMs
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 在心理健康应用中的使用日益增加，人们担心它会内化并延续社会偏见。这项研究评估 GPT-4 与 GPT-5 在表征不同性别群体心理健康感知时存在的差异与错位，共包含两项研究。研究一采用被广泛使用的社会距离、刻板印象与求助态度量表，考察 AI 模型是否呈现出系统性的性别差异。（可见摘要未提供研究结论与第二项研究的具体设计。）
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16042v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in mental health applications raises concerns about its potential to internalize and perpetuate societal biases. This research evaluates both disparities and misalignment in how large language models (LLMs), GPT-4 and GPT-5, represent perceptions of mental health across gender groups. The research comprises two studies. Study 1 applied widely adopted measures of Social Distance, Stereotypes, and Attitudes Toward Seeking Help to assess whether the AI models depict systematic gender differences.…
items.why_zh: 如果心理健康类 AI 系统性地放大性别偏见，将直接影响其在高敏感场景中的公平性与可信度。
items.why_en: If mental-health AI systematically amplifies gender bias, it undermines fairness and trust in highly sensitive applications.

items.title_zh: GeoReader：为视觉语言模型学习用于空间推理的隐式几何
items.title_en: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）难以处理 RGB 观测中隐而未显的度量关系与多视角关系。几何基础模型能够从 RGB 中恢复这类结构，但现有做法要么把估计出的几何特征与视觉 token 融合、仅靠问答任务学会如何使用它们，要么把 VLM 的隐表示与几何特征对齐。问题在于“捕获几何”不等于“使用几何”：在一个已发布的对齐模型上，把对齐后的隐表示置零，其准确率竟然毫无变化。为此作者提出 GeoReader 框架，让模型真正学会利用几何信息。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18694v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that lea…
items.why_zh: 它点破了“对齐了却没在用”的隐表示假象，为 VLM 空间推理提供了更可靠的几何利用方式。
items.why_en: It exposes the illusion of aligned-but-unused latents and offers a more faithful way to exploit geometry in VLM spatial reasoning.

items.title_zh: HALLMARK：如何诊断 LLM 引文核查器，以及何时该部署它们
items.title_en: HALLMARK: How to Diagnose LLM Citation Verifiers and When to Deploy Them
items.summary_zh: GPTZero 发现 NeurIPS 2025 录用的 53 篇论文存在虚构引文，如今不少会议已用自动参考文献检查工具筛查投稿。基于规则与基于大模型的核查器不断涌现，但许多发布时缺少共同评测标准，且各自标记的错误类型不同，令人难以判断该信任哪一个、何时部署。为此作者提出 HALLMARK（幻觉基准）：包含 2,526 条 BibTeX 条目、覆盖 14 类幻觉，带有分类型与诊断性子测试标签，以及进一步的时间、跨领域等维度标注。
